name: Denver International
subtitle: Stand assignment and push control for Concourses A, B and C, the RON pads, the Cargo Ramp and the GA Ramp
source: Concourse stands and headings, taxiways (Purple, Green and Orange taxilanes coloured), aprons and buildings from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL): each stand 20 m back from the jet-bridge end of its lead-in line. Gate list, apron control markings 2W-8W / 2E-8E and apron frequencies from the Jeppesen 10-9B (25 SEP 26, user-supplied). OSM's DS1-DS16 are the chart's DS4-DS19 (renumbered). A23, C52 and C57-C67, which OSM lacks, are placed from their chart labels (the 10-9B is evenly gridded, ~1.42 m/px) shifted by their OSM neighbours' label offsets. Cargo Ramp and GA Ramp stands are read off satellite screenshots, georeferenced to OSM's DHL / UPS / FedEx and Menzies outlines (within a few metres); their names are ours, not published. Generated frames: north up, 1.5 m/px, linear in lat/lon.

airlines.name: Delta, Alaska, JetBlue, Spirit, Sun Country, Allegiant, Air Canada, WestJet

airlinesSource: Approximate: United on Concourse B (United Express on B's south side and B East), Southwest on C, Frontier and the other airlines and international carriers on A, American on A then C. FedEx, UPS and DHL on their own parts of the Cargo Ramp. RON pads, the CE pads and the GA Ramp are not given out automatically.
notes: Apron control markings: Concourse A south 2W/2E, A north 3W/3E, B south 4W/4E, B north 5W/5E, C south 6W/6E, C north 7W/7E, DS RON pads 8W/8E.
Apron frequencies (10-9B): A north 129.05, A south 131.975, B north 130.95, B south 130.6, C north 119.475, C south 131.3.
Purple, Green and Orange taxilanes are drawn in their colours. Wingspan limits on the 10-9B apply (e.g. Orange: less than 94 ft; Purple south of A: less than 171 ft).
Cargo Ramp and GA Ramp: no published stands, spots or frequencies. Stand names there (DHL1, UPS1, FDX1, GA1...) are ours.
GA Ramp is for awareness only: the map shows the aircraft parked there, not parking spots.
